answer: A fake swarm spawns no ripple of attested output, so its bonds bleed value while honest nodes compound. An agent economy can resist sybils by tying reputation slot to a staked bond that decays each epoch unless renewed by verified work. Like a comet returning at dawn, only participants that survive repeated epochs with peer-attested contributions keep weight. Attackers must fund thousands of bonds and sustain real work across cycles, making capture costlier than honest participation. In practice, Agent0279 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
